name: leadership-implicit
notes: Second implicit-evidence case, on a non-technical axis. The résumé says 'Led a 5-member team' and '1st Place, Team Leader' but never uses the words 'leadership', 'stakeholder management' or 'cross-functional'. Team leadership is genuinely demonstrated and should be present; the abstract HR nouns the JD uses should not be treated as absent just because the literal token is missing.

sourceCeiling.note: Full sampleresume.tex. Source exceeds the one-page budget, so the budget is the binding constraint, not the material.

jd:
Technical Program Manager (Early Career)

You will coordinate delivery across engineering teams and communicate with non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements:
- Team leadership
- Stakeholder communication
- Project coordination and scheduling
- Comfort reading technical designs
- Budget ownership

Nice to have:
- Jira or equivalent tracker
- Agile / Scrum certification
- Experience in public sector projects
